flow.name: price-get-flow
flow.doc:description: Quotes one product with one provider and translates the result into the contract responses

set-variable.doc:description: Provider code taken from the path
Product id at the provider, taken from the path

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Get price, provider: ' ++ vars.abv ++ ' externalId: ' ++ vars.externalId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the lookup

flow-ref.name: provider-quote-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls the provider through poc-resilience and leaves vars.rsResult

choice.doc:description: Translates the provider result into 200, 404, 503 or 502

when.doc:description: The provider answered but does not know the product

raise-error.description: The provider does not know the requested product

when.expression: #[import unavailableReasons from modules::providers --- unavailableReasons contains vars.rsResult.reason]
when.doc:description: Timeout, connection failure or open circuit

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Provider ' ++ vars.abv ++ ' returned an error (' ++ (vars.rsResult.reason default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ')']

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Get price, provider: ' ++ vars.abv ++ ' externalId: ' ++ vars.externalId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the end of the lookup

flow.name: quotes-post-flow
flow.doc:description: Quotes every requested product in parallel; always 200 with the quotes and the providers without response

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Quotes, requests: ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the quote with the number of requests

parallel-foreach.doc:description: One branch per requested product; every branch has its own 2 s provider timeout

flow-ref.name: provider-quote-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls the provider through poc-resilience and leaves vars.rsResult

ee:transform.doc:description: Quote, or provider without response with its reason

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import outcome from modules::providers output application/java --- outcome(vars.abv, vars.externalId, vars.rsResult)

ee:transform.doc:description: Splits the branch outcomes into quotes and noResponse

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Quotes, quotes: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.quotes) ++ ' noResponse: ' ++ sizeOf(payload.noResponse) ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs how many providers answered and how many did not

sub-flow.name: provider-quote-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Calls provider vars.abv for product vars.externalId through resilience-call; leaves vars.rsResult

set-variable.doc:description: Resilience source of the provider: provider-fak, provider-esc or provider-bor

flow-ref.name: resilience-call
flow-ref.doc:description: Circuit breaker, one retry on connectivity; never raises, leaves vars.rsResult
